verdict.rationale: For payment-card purchases, Skyfire documents cardholder consent. An authorization covers a specific merchant and amount, and "the agent/agent platform can never spend more than the cardholder approved," backed by user mandate collection through the card networks. In the core wallet flow, however, agents with a pre-funded wallet create signed, amount-capped pay tokens on their own via the API/MCP, and no human confirmation step is documented. Those tokens cannot be revoked per token once issued. Missing for 10: a documented human approval or confirmation step for wallet-based pay token creation, configurable thresholds for when spending counts as sensitive, per-token revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the card consent flow.
